name: streamkit-tiktok-bridge
description: TikTok LIVE socket + overlay WebSocket fan-out. State lives in Convex.

scripts.test: node --check server.js && node --check frames.js && node -e "import('./frames.js').then(m=>{const u={nickname:'a',uniqueId:'a'};const a=m.toFrame('comment',{content:'new field',user:u});const b=m.toFrame('comment',{comment:'old field',user:u});if(a.type!=='comment'||a.text!=='new field'||b.text!=='old field')throw new Error('comment text fields broken');console.log('frames ok',JSON.stringify(a),JSON.stringify(b))})"
